viewing_check: Estimate 30-50, current bid $15. Value is mostly the ivory crank phone: ivory PMG rotary phones sell $140-230 (dated 2024-25), black crank phones $20-110, so an ivory crank phone could be $80-200 if working/complete; no ivory crank sale found. Check it is complete (handset, cord, bell/internals, crank), cracks and yellowing. Horse worth about $30-90 if undamaged (check ears, legs, harness). Blue Princess phones and LED lights are near-worthless. Prices fairly stable, mostly 2025.
